class.name: VoxelMaterial
class.description: Controls how a [VoxelVolume3D] shades its ray-marched voxels. The same resource can be assigned to multiple volumes; editing it updates every volume that references it. Each volume keeps only its generated shader and volume-specific GPU textures private. Texture inputs are palette lookup textures rather than UV-mapped mesh textures: each stored voxel ID selects one texel. When a texture is empty, the corresponding legacy texture on [VoxelShapeData] is used for compatibility.

method.name: get_albedo_modulate
method.description: Returns the color multiplied with every palette entry.

method.name: get_emission_energy
method.description: Returns the multiplier applied to emission values from the voxel material texture.

method.name: get_metallic_multiplier
method.description: Returns the multiplier applied to palette metallic values.

method.name: get_outline_color
method.description: Returns the color of voxel normal-discontinuity outlines.

method.name: get_outline_width
method.description: Returns the approximate outline width in screen pixels.

method.name: get_roughness_multiplier
method.description: Returns the multiplier applied to palette roughness values.

method.name: get_specularity_multiplier
method.description: Returns the multiplier applied to palette specularity values.

method.name: is_outline_enabled
method.description: Returns whether normal-discontinuity outlines are enabled.

method.name: set_albedo_modulate
method.description: Sets the color multiplied with every palette entry.

method.name: get_shading_mode
method.description: Returns the active voxel shading mode.

method.name: get_lighting_position_mode
method.description: Returns whether direct lighting uses the exact surface hit or the center of the voxel face.

method.name: set_emission_energy
method.description: Sets the non-negative multiplier applied to voxel emission.

method.name: set_shading_mode
method.description: Selects unlit or physically based shading. Changing the mode rebuilds an existing runtime shader.

method.name: set_lighting_position_mode
method.description: Selects exact-hit lighting or intentionally quantized voxel-face lighting. Visibility and shadow rays always originate at the exact surface hit.

method.name: set_metallic_multiplier
method.description: Sets the non-negative palette metallic multiplier.

method.name: set_outline_color
method.description: Sets the outline color and opacity.

method.name: set_outline_enabled
method.description: Enables outlines where voxel surface normals change or a surface ends.

method.name: set_outline_width
method.description: Sets the approximate outline width in screen pixels.

method.name: set_roughness_multiplier
method.description: Sets the non-negative palette roughness multiplier.

method.name: set_specularity_multiplier
method.description: Sets the non-negative palette specularity multiplier.

members.member: Color multiplied with every palette albedo. This changes the whole material without altering [VoxelShapeData].
Multiplier applied to the emission channel of [member VoxelShapeData.material_texture]. Values below zero are clamped to zero.
Determines whether the generated voxel shader is unlit or participates in PBR lighting.

Controls positional quantization for direct lighting. Voxel face center is the default and gives every pixel on one voxel face the same direct-light sample. Exact hit retains flat voxel normals but allows lighting intensity to vary across the face.
Combined palette material lookup: roughness in red, metallic in green, and emission in blue.
Multiplier applied to palette-indexed metallic values.
Palette-indexed metallic lookup. When present, this overrides the combined material texture's metallic channel.
Color and opacity of voxel normal-discontinuity outlines.
Draws outlines at silhouettes and where neighboring voxel faces turn. Coplanar occupied voxels are not outlined, so this does not add a grid over flat surfaces.
Approximate outline width in screen pixels.
Palette-indexed albedo lookup. Voxel ID [code]n[/code] selects texel [code]n[/code].
Multiplier applied to palette-indexed roughness values.
Multiplier applied to palette-indexed specularity values.
Palette-indexed specularity lookup. Roughness is derived from its inverse when supplied.

constants.constant: Uses an unshaded spatial shader. Palette color and emission are visible without scene lighting.
Uses scene lighting with palette albedo and palette-indexed specularity, roughness, metallic, transparency, and emission values.
Evaluates light direction and attenuation at the exact visible surface hit while retaining the flat voxel face normal.
Evaluates direct lighting at the voxel face center for a deliberately stepped, block-locked appearance. Shadows still use the exact surface hit.
